description: Reference imagery to compare the model against, and the camera pose that reproduces each one. Consumed by any viewer implementing the compare feature; see REFERENCE-VIEWS.md in digital-3d-shared-contracts.
pose_disclaimer: Every camera pose in this file is AUTHOR-SET, graded D, and carries no source. No registered source states where a photographer stood or what focal length they used. A pose is a starting point for the eye, never evidence. Nudge it freely; nothing in the model depends on it.

views.title: HAER measured drawing — elevation
views.subtitle: Park Row to Adams Street, datumed to mean high water
views.credit: Historic American Engineering Record, HAER No. NY-18, sheet 1 of 1, delineator Paul Berry. Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division.
views.license: Work of the U.S. Government. No known copyright restrictions.
views.notes: The highest-value overlay in this file: a scaled orthographic elevation of the same structure, on the same vertical datum the model authors in. Use it to check the span chain, the tower heights and the deck profile in one glance.

views.title: HAER measured drawing — plan

views.credit: Historic American Engineering Record, HAER No. NY-18, sheet 1 of 1, delineator Paul Berry. Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division.
views.license: Work of the U.S. Government. No known copyright restrictions.
views.notes: Shows the Brooklyn Curve carrying the walkway away from the roadway, which is the arrangement OQ-014 records as not yet modelled in plan.

views.title: HAER measured drawing — Manhattan tower detail
views.subtitle: Arch geometry, caisson depth, clearances
views.credit: Historic American Engineering Record, HAER No. NY-18, sheet 1 of 1, delineator Paul Berry. Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division.
views.license: Work of the U.S. Government. No known copyright restrictions.
views.notes: The source of CTL-020, CTL-026 to CTL-030 and both caisson depths. Overlay this to see the arch and the taper the model still guesses at (OQ-004).

views.title: Broadside from the East River
